skill.name: trello-automation
skill.description: Guide Trello automation through Rube MCP for boards, lists, cards, assignments, comments, attachments, and search workflows.
skill.summary: Automate Trello board and card workflows through Rube MCP tool sequences.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code for MCP tool and parameter names. The skill does require an external Rube MCP endpoint and Trello authorization, so the network and third-party access boundary are real risks to disclose. No prompt injection or malicious command execution was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External MCP service and Trello authorization are required.
remediation.suggestion: Document the Trello data Rube can access, required authorization scopes, and when user confirmation is needed before writes.

remediation.issue: Markdown tool names were flagged as shell execution by static analysis.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that inline backtick values are MCP tool names and parameters, not shell commands to run locally.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Trello connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `trello`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER` - List boards to find target board ID [Prerequisite]
2. `TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD` - Get lists on board to find target list ID [Prerequisite]
3. `TRELLO_ADD_CARDS` - Create the card on the resolved list [Required]
4. `TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_CHECKLISTS_BY_ID_CARD` - Add a checklist to the card [Optional]
1. `TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER` - List all boards for the user [Required]
1. `TRELLO_GET_SEARCH` - Find the card by name or keyword [Prerequisite]
3. `TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD` - Update card's idList to move it [Required]
1. `TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_MEMBERS_BY_ID_BOARD` - Get member IDs from the board [Prerequisite]
2. `TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ID_MEMBERS_BY_ID_CARD` - Add a member to the card [Required]
- `query`: Search string (supports board:, list:, label:, is:open/archived operators)
1. `TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_CARD` - Post a comment on the card [Required]
- `text`: Comment text (1-16384 chars, supports Markdown and @mentions)
- **List name → List ID**: `TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD` with resolved board ID
- **Card name → Card ID**: `TRELLO_GET_SEARCH` with query string
Most list endpoints return all items. For boards with 1000+ cards, use `limit` and `before` paramete
300 requests per 10 seconds per token. Use `TRELLO_GET_BATCH` for bulk read operations to stay withi
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Store returned id (idCard) immediately; downstream checklist operations fail without it

content.value_statement: Trello work often requires repeated board, list, and card updates. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for Rube MCP and an authenticated Trello connection.
Lists Trello tool sequences for creating cards and adding checklists.
Explains how to resolve board, list, card, and member names to IDs.
Supports workflows for moving cards, assigning members, and adding comments.
Documents search, pagination, nested response, and rate limit pitfalls.
limitations: Requires a configured Rube MCP server and active Trello authorization.
Does not provide offline Trello access or standalone executable code.
Depends on current Rube and Trello tool schemas and account permissions.
Large write operations can hit Trello rate limits without batching or pacing.

use_cases.title: Create Project Tasks
use_cases.description: Create Trello cards with descriptions, due dates, and checklist items after resolving board and list IDs.

use_cases.title: Move Work Through Statuses
use_cases.description: Find cards by name, verify the match, and move them to the correct destination list.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Team Assignments
use_cases.description: Look up board members and assign people to cards without replacing existing card membership.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Trello automation skill to create a card named "Customer follow-up" on my Sales board in the To Do list. Resolve IDs first.

prompt_templates.title: Move and Assign a Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the card named "API cleanup", verify the exact match, move it to In Progress, and assign it to Maya.

prompt_templates.title: Search Board Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my open Trello cards tagged release across active boards. Summarize matches by board, list, due date, and assigned member.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Rollout Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create launch tasks from this checklist on the Product board, add owners, set due dates, add comments, and pace requests for rate limits.

output_examples.input: Create a card for onboarding tasks with a checklist on the HR board.
output: Resolved the HR board and Onboarding list IDs.
Created the onboarding card with the requested description.
Added the checklist items and reported the created card ID.

output_examples.input: Move the Q3 roadmap card to Done and assign Sam.
output: Found matching Q3 roadmap cards and confirmed the intended board.
Resolved the Done list and Sam member IDs.
Moved the card and added Sam without replacing other members.

output_examples.input: Find overdue support cards across my boards.
output_examples.output: Returns a concise list grouped by board and list, including card names, due dates, members, and direct Trello references.

best_practices: Resolve display names to Trello IDs before every write operation.
Confirm card names and destination lists before moving or updating cards.
Batch reads and pace writes to stay within Trello rate limits.
anti_patterns: Using board URL slugs when a board ID or shortLink is required.
Replacing a card member list when the goal is to add one assignee.
Creating large checklist imports without planning for rate limits.

faq.question: Does this skill require Trello authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an active Trello connection through Rube MCP before workflows can run.

faq.question: Can it create new Trello cards?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the board lookup, list lookup, and card creation tool sequence.

faq.question: Can it move existing cards?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches for the card, resolves the destination list, and updates the card list ID.

faq.question: Does it handle Trello display names directly?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the agent to resolve names to IDs before calling Trello tools.

faq.question: Can it attach files or URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes the Trello attachment workflow and notes the required attachment fields.

faq.question: Is this a standalone Trello client?
faq.answer: No. It is a workflow guide for AI agents using Rube MCP Trello tools.
